title: Subdivision Surface Modifier
direct_observations: Catmull-Clark vs Simple subdivision modes; Simple only smooths non-coplanar geometry
Levels Viewport vs Render are independent, viewport should not exceed render
Use Limit Surface places verts at the theoretical infinite-subdivision position

title: Empties (incl. Image Empty reference-modeling workflow)
direct_observations: Image Empty displays a reference photo directly in the 3D viewport for continuous comparison while modeling
Depth=Front + low Opacity is the recommended setting when using an image as a modeling reference
candidate_principles: Reference-based modeling should compare against the source continuously (or via repeated renders for a non-visual agent), not once at the end -- root cause of the first (rejected) gadget blockout attempt

title: Editing Mesh Objects (mesh editing operator index)
direct_observations: Official operator taxonomy: Mesh/Vertex/Edge/Face/UV operator groups, used to derive this session's reproduction-lab operation list

title: Bevel (edge/vertex)
direct_observations: Width Type has 5 variants (Offset/Width/Depth/Percent/Absolute) with different meanings for the same Width number -- this project has only ever used bmesh.ops.bevel defaults, never explicitly varied Width Type
Clamp Overlap prevents overshoot past neighboring faces; Miter Outer/Inner controls extra geometry at multi-edge corners to avoid pinching
experiments: see knowledge/foundation/operator_cards/bevel.md -- pre-existing project findings, not fresh this session

title: BMesh Operators (bmesh.ops) Python API reference
direct_observations: grid_fill(bm, edges, mat_nr, use_smooth, use_interp_simple) has NO span/offset parameters (unlike the higher-level bpy.ops.mesh.fill_grid) -- confirmed via WebSearch cross-reference, not the truncated page alone
Official chain-link example script demonstrates bridge_loops called on edges from two independently-generated spin operations, matching the corrected reproduction in this session
